description.en: Same as CreateSpeech, but also hides the speaker's name label (via CMND_WASHA_NAME_HIDE) once the message opens — used for anonymous or already-established speakers.
Optional speaker slot for the speech bubble (defaults to 0).
Optional; whether to show the bubble on the right side (defaults to false).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Show a speech-bubble message without a speaker name label
CreateSpeechHide("ev700");
